pages.text: Day six. Toby gets upset, and a log zooms into the pond. Splash!
pages.picture: day six: a fallen log zooming through the air and landing in the pond with a big splash; Toby on the bank, cross, spikes up; Julia shielding her face from the spray

pages.text: Day nine. A branch shoots up and lands on the play house. Crunch!
pages.picture: day nine: a big leafy branch crashing down onto the playhouse's green roof, crunch, bits flying; Julia and Toby by the garden gate, aghast

pages.text: Day ten. Toby sits on a log and sighs. "I can not do it," he said. "I give up."
pages.picture: day ten: Toby sitting on the fallen log in the clearing, slumped, sighing, giving up

pages.text: "No, you can," said Julia. But she is fed up too.
pages.picture: Julia sitting on the fallen log beside Toby, both tired and fed up, Julia with her chin in her hand

pages.text: It is dusk. Julia sits on the grass with her hand up, flat. "Just one last go," she said.
pages.picture: Julia sitting on the grass with her hand held out flat, palm up, "just one last go"; a small leafy branch lies on the grass in front of her; Toby sitting a little way off on the fallen log
pages.time: dusk: pink and orange sky, the light fading, long shadows

pages.text: Toby is not looking at the branch. He is looking at Julia. He is not cross. He is not sad.
pages.picture: Toby looking gently at Julia, not at the branch; calm, spikes smooth, a soft face; Julia sitting with her palm up
pages.time: dusk: pink and orange sky, the light fading, long shadows

pages.text: And then the branch lifts up. It drifts this way. It drifts that way.
pages.picture: the small leafy branch floating gently up in the dusk air, drifting this way and that, glowing softly; Julia's open hand below it; Toby calmly watching Julia
pages.time: dusk: pink and orange sky, the light fading, long shadows

pages.text: It floats down, soft as a leaf, and lands in Julia's hand.
pages.picture: the small leafy branch landing softly in Julia's open hand, light as a leaf; Julia's face amazed
pages.time: dusk: pink and orange sky, the light fading, long shadows

pages.text: Julia looks at the branch. Toby looks at the branch. "Toby!" said Julia. "You did it!"
pages.picture: Julia and Toby both staring at the branch in her hand, amazed; Julia shouting with joy
pages.time: dusk: pink and orange sky, the light fading, long shadows

pages.text: Toby blinks. "I did it," he said. "I did it! But how?"
pages.picture: Toby blinking in amazement, big eyes, a wondering look; Julia holding the branch up to him
pages.time: dusk: pink and orange sky, the light fading, long shadows
